name: Contracted-vs-catalog source switch mid-quote (IsContracted toggled / asset detach)
expected: Toggling the contracted source re-routes the line between the ContactedPricing branch and the catalog waterfall: contracted->catalog re-derives PricingDate from EffectiveFrom (no stale-date carryover, catalog list applies); catalog->contracted seeds PricingDate=EffectiveDate (ContactedPricing28). A line first priced contracted (PricingDate seeded) then detached (IsContracted=false) reprices to catalog list with a reset PricingDate.
actual: Could not smoke-test the source-switch transition. Org-wide query: 0 of all QuoteLineItems and 0 of all OrderItems in FortraUAT have PricingContractId set (engine IsContracted is derived from PricingContractId), so the ContactedPricing branch (IsContracted==true) has NEVER fired on any real record and no contracted->catalog toggle exists to reprice. No known-good contracted positive control to clone. Catalog-side half is healthy: both real control lines (Cobalt Strike QLI 0QLWC000003HRWi4AO Unit/List=20500; 5250 Integrator QLI 0QLWC000003kESr4AM Net=6539.75) have PricingContractId=null and route the non-contracted catalog/derived path.
evidence: SOQL: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM QuoteLineItem WHERE PricingContractId!=null => 0; same on OrderItem => 0 (29408 Activated Contracts exist but none drives line pricing). Procedure live retrieve Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition-meta.xml lines 1508-1589: ContactedPricing filter (IsContracted IsNotNull AND IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull) -> ContactedPricing28 assigns PricingDate=EffectiveDate; lines 3027-3076: unconditional PricingEffectiveDates assigns PricingDate=EffectiveFrom for every line each reprice. Describe: PricingDate and IsContracted are NOT persisted columns on QuoteLineItem/OrderItem (only PricingContractId reference exists), so no stale PricingDate can carry over between reprices. Control lines: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003HRWi4AO/view , https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kESr4AM/view
notes: Not a V21 defect. Two reasons preflight fails. (1) DATA: the Contracted Pricing feature is wired in the procedure but unused in this org -- 0 lines carry a PricingContractId, so IsContracted is never true and the ContactedPricing branch cannot be toggled mid-quote; there is no real contracted record to clone as a positive control (brief mandates a known-good control before trusting a fixture). Standing up the full Contracted Pricing structure (active Contract + contract-priced product + contract pricing schedule that resolves IsContracted) is an unvalidated hand-built input that, per the brief's #1 trap + headless-harness artifact warning, cannot serve as defect evidence; constraints forbid deploys/edits. (2) MECHANISM: PricingDate and IsContracted are transient pricing-engine context fields, NOT persisted on QLI/OI. PricingEffectiveDates (unconditional, seq 4) re-assigns PricingDate=EffectiveFrom on every reprice, so the 'stale contracted PricingDate pins an old pricebook date' failure mode is structurally impossible across reprices -- there is no persisted PricingDate to carry. The catalog-route (negative IsContracted) half is confirmed healthy on both real control lines (PricingContractId=null -> catalog/derived path, correct prices). The transition that A-06 uniquely tests (vs steady-state A-02/A-04) is untestable on real data. defect_provenance='none / completeness-gap' -- baseline expected PASS, downgraded to BLOCKED for lack of a contracted fixture/control. To finish: build a UI-priced contracted line (Quote Line Editor with a Contract that has contract pricing) and confirm contracted price + PricingDate seed, then null PricingContractId and reprice to confirm catalog list + reset PricingDate.
verdict_reason: The ContactedPricing/IsContracted source-switch branch cannot be exercised because zero lines in FortraUAT carry a PricingContractId (no contracted line ever existed) and no known-good contracted control is available to clone, so preflight fails and the transition is unverifiable rather than failing.
